ai_summary: Global Education Limited's 15th Annual General Meeting was held on July 31, 2026, where shareholders considered key proposals including the adoption of FY26 financial statements, declaration of a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share (bringing the total for FY26 to ₹1.00 per share with an interim dividend), and several director re-appointments, notably the continuation of the Chairman's directorship beyond 75 years of age. While these items were considered, the document explicitly states that the voting results are pending and will be disclosed later, thus preventing confirmation of any material financial or governance impacts at this time.
